mechanism_narrative: Sustained federal funds rates at or below 0.5% indicate active monetary easing, reducing equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.5% (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment above 8.0% and monthly payroll growth exceeding 0.5% signal labor market recovery, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances meeting the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 650k and retail sales above 400k indicate robust consumer demand, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of triggered cases.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 95 signals manufacturing contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 95.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly CPI inflation exceeding 0.3% signals rising inflation concerns, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of triggered cases.

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth below 1.0% quarterly during late-cycle expansion indicates economic vulnerability, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances meeting the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate above 8.0% consistently signals weak labor market conditions, generating negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent low interest rates (FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.5%) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL MoM > 0.3%) indicate stagflationary risks, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances meeting the trigger condition.
